newsitem.title: USA: Barringer sees sees Q4 sales, income flat.
newsitem.headline: Barringer sees sees Q4 sales, income flat.

text.p: Barringer Laboratories Inc said Monday, after the market closed, that fourth quarter 1996 sales should equal 1995 sales levels and income for 1996 will be consistent with 1995 income.
The company said that there is still uncertainty in the environmental market.
Barringer reported third quarter earnings of $0.23 a share on revenues of $2.1 million, compared to $0.13 a share on revenues of $1.9 million the previous third quarter.
Previous year results were not immediately available.
